test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

MIST - TIMS - ISMT

HOPE - EOHP - OPHE
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** Rearrange letters in a specific pattern:

First word → second word (letters rearranged in a fixed order)

Second word → third word (letters rearranged in another fixed order)

Given,

**MIST → TIMS → ISMT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92ddfebe184d77c45851f76060d582dd25f24b30c566e7b8dc933b76ccfd15e0.png] 

**HOPE → EOHP → OPHE**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc50889451eb5b7e362f90b101117e99d86eb1251393d6df3544e8972fed5ffd.png] 

Now, checking the options:

Option 1) PUTS → UPTS → SUTP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be84c9abbac16a6bebf88f3b092569ef453fe9ae31e970ed79bf4bf55c75a574.png] 

**Option 2) BUSY → YUBS → USBY**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e469fc48c51df6b789e0300121387c91199852da37103cd6c7abf37c46d545e0.png] 

Option 3) WIDE → EIWD → DIWE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01fbf8a61c85939f70a7b5d4e172a1cfbedddc204c17a9acb2b1cacc8afea8df.png] 

Option 4) NUMB → NMUB → BMUN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3aafe1563157b8b7e2cd947c30cadbc6e300e878a66beedd45bfa7964643eccf.png] 

Hence, the correct option is **"Option 2"**.
